grades.reason: Describes RISC-V vector arithmetic instruction formats and operand ordering. It has nothing to do with updating selected CSR bits while preserving other fields.

grades.quote: The `BSTRINS.D` instruction performs the operation that replaces the `[msbd:lsbd]` bit in the general register `rd` with the `[msbd-lsbd:0]` bit in the general register `rj` , and the rest of the general register `rd` remains unchanged.
grades.reason: BSTRINS replaces a bit range in a general register and leaves the remaining bits unchanged. It works on GPRs, not CSRs, and no CSR access instruction is described. So it is only a loosely related auxiliary technique for a read-modify-write of a control register.
Covers custom extensions of the Control Transfer Records feature. It does not explain how to modify selected CSR bits without overwriting other fields.
Defines the fields of the LLBCTL register. It does not describe a general mechanism, such as a masked exchange or set/clear instruction, for changing selected CSR bits while preserving the rest.
